Look. Based on how /v/iama and /v/ama are currently functioning, one of two things must be done. Pick either of the options. I don't have a preference for one or another, but this needs to be settled.

Option #1) The /v/iama and /v/ama must be merged. It is ridiculous that nobody knows which subverse to submit their discussions when it comes to reaching a wider audience, or a more engaged audience. People are so confused by it that I am seeing x-posts of the same discussions in two different subverses, with people asking questions in one subverse that have already been answered in another. This is a problem, and it needs to be solved.

Option #2) Okay. So, for whatever reason, the powers-that-be do not want to merge. Fine. I get it. But if you are not going to merge, then there needs to be some communication between the moderators of the two subverses in regards to the focus of each one. It has been suggested that one should be focused on ordinary people, while the other should focus on celebrities or semi-celebrities that are initiating a discussion. I really support this idea, actually. But the moderators need to lay out the rules in a clear and concise way over in the sidebars of the subverses. Users need to know where they should be submitting their content. Each subverse needs to state which kind of AMAs can be submitted to that particular subverse, and which kind of AMAs can be submitted to the other subverse, so that we are all on the same page.

My personal opinion: Option #1 would be the easiest in terms of people knowing where to go for this particular type of content. There would be no confusion at all. And if people are really concerned about the Reddit trademark for "IAMA" then selecting "AMA" as the official subverse would make the most sense -- especially if Voat went the extra mile and trademarked "AMA" in the same way that Reddit has trademarked "IAMA." But if people are insistent on having two subverses that have a different focus, then here is what I think it should be: if you have your own Wikipedia page, then you should submit to /v/iama. If you don't have a Wikipedia page, then you should submit to /v/ama. It's as simple as that. Whoever has the ability to make this happen, please make this happen.
